releases: api-rmw5fvr9h-5d8aa3 (#301: flag removed from deploy.json — stayed on; see findings)

checks.immutable: 28 of 30; the other 2 answers carry program errors, which are never cached (no-store), as they should be

findings: Removing an INTERPRETER_ flag from deploy.json does not turn it off: the deploy CLI uses --update-env-vars, which keeps variables it isn't given. Flags are turned off by value ("off"). Follow-up: the deploy CLI should refuse a release that drops a flag the live service still has.

Cloudflare caches api.graffiticode.org/form redirects for an hour (Cache-Control: max-age=3600), so after a generation change browsers can be sent data URLs naming the previous generation. Those are answered no-store with correct data, so nothing wrong is served, but View caching degrades for up to an hour. Follow-up: /form should send no-store or a short max-age, or a flip should purge /form.
